subject.title: [Feature Request] SKILL.md Instruction Isolation from Agent Context

question: What trusted/untrusted SKILL.md precedence model and per-skill authority contract should OpenClaw enforce for role, memory, and tool influence?
rationale: This choice defines a security boundary, public skill metadata, runtime enforcement behavior, and upgrade compatibility; the current source shows the gap but does not determine the safe permanent contract.

options.title: Approve phased core security design
options.body: Start with a written skill trust/authority contract, then land metadata, enforcement, regression tests, and docs in reviewable phases.

options.title: Limit this to inspection and scanning
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged for now and coordinate this issue with the open manifest and Markdown-scanner work as visibility-only hardening.

options.title: Defer to plugin governance
options.body: Close or narrow core work if maintainers decide external governance plugins and current tool policies are the intended boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve phased core security design
recommendation.body: Start with a written skill trust/authority contract, then land metadata, enforcement, regression tests, and docs in reviewable phases.

likelyOwner.reason: The live issue review and current prompt-area blame both point to this owner as the best available routing candidate for the unresolved security/product boundary.
